title: Immediate Mode Explained
summary: Retained vs immediate mode, the per-frame loop, the core + platform + renderer backend architecture, ImGuiIO, and where UI state really lives.

quiz.q: In immediate mode, how do you remove a button from the UI?
options: Set its visible flag to false
quiz.explain: Widgets only exist while you call them. If you don't call it this frame, it isn't there.
The core never calls OpenGL. The renderer backend imgui_impl_opengl2.cpp draws the triangles ImGui produces.

quiz.q: The user is typing an entity name and presses D. How should the engine avoid moving the camera?
options: It can't - both will always react
quiz.explain: ImGui sets io.WantCaptureKeyboard when a widget wants the keyboard. Skip game input while it is true.

quiz.q: Where is the checked/unchecked state of ImGui::Checkbox("Grid", &gShowGrid) stored?
quiz.explain: You pass a pointer to your own data. ImGui reads it to draw and writes it on click.
